title: The Lead Belt
dek: Bangladesh's lead poisoning crisis mapped: 294 contaminated sites, 145 schools within 500 metres, and soil lead readings up to 1,702 times the international safety standard.
summary: A forensic spatial investigation mapping contaminated lead sites, nearby schools, child exposure indicators, and state inaction across Bangladesh.
key_findings: 294 contaminated sites are mapped across Bangladesh using Pure Earth / University of Dhaka assessment data.
145 schools are identified within 500 metres of contaminated sites, with the closest school in the report sitting 59 metres from a lead-acid battery recycling site.
The highest soil lead reading in the report reaches 680,872 ppm, about 1,702 times the 400 ppm international residential safety threshold.
